title: YouResult
description: Server to one, event `you:result`. Private result of the player's Day action, sent when Day ends. Blocked and faked results look exactly like normal ones. Client text: Search null = "You found nothing", Commune null = "The dead are silent", Candle blocked = "The Monster blocked your candle".

trait.description: Search and Commune only. Search: a trait the Monster has. Commune: a trait the Monster does not have. Null when nothing was found.

candleBlocked.description: Candle only. Sent as false for a normal candle so every Candle gets a result. A save itself is never reported.
